'''Thul Kariss''' was an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] of unknown gender who served under [[Cala Worner]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] co-piloting the [[Midnight Star]], a modified [[YV-545 light freighter]]. They worked for the [[Outer Rim Trade Consortium]], but secretly recruited for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
